site.name: ArchLens
site.tagline: Free cloud architecture security and cost analyzer
site.summary: ArchLens is a free web tool that reviews cloud architecture for security risks and cost savings. You upload an infrastructure file (Terraform, Kubernetes YAML, Helm, Docker Compose, Dockerfile, CloudFormation, Azure ARM, Serverless, OpenAPI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure Pipelines, Ansible, AWS Config or GCP asset exports, draw.io diagrams), draw the architecture on a canvas, or describe it in plain English, and it lists security findings, cost-saving findings and a monthly cost estimate across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud.
